title: Genie One enhancements
body:
* **Collaborative document editing**: People you share a Genie One document with can now edit it if they have CAN EDIT permission. See [Share a document](/aws/en/genie-one/documents#share).
* **Group memberships in user info**: When Genie One retrieves a user's information, it now also returns the user's group memberships. You can use workspace instructions and table descriptions to tailor how Genie One responds to members of specific groups.
* **Reuse context from past investigations**: When you ask a question similar to one you asked before, Genie One can now use the context from the earlier investigation to answer faster. See [Recall past conversations](/aws/en/genie-one/chat#recall-past-conversations).
